description: The dependency that matters here is the Dockerfile FROM pin on docker.io/eceasy/cli-proxy-api. Renovate bumping it (tag + digest) is the entry point of the release chain: the PR is built and tested by the image workflow, the merge is auto-tagged by the autotag workflow, the tag publishes to ghcr.io, and k8s-conf's own Renovate then proposes the digest-pinned deploy bump. Go module updates are grouped and non-urgent; the upstream/ submodule is a deliberate compatibility pin (make verify-upstream) and must never be auto-bumped.

packageRules.description: Group Go module bumps into one PR; they gate on make test in CI
